entities.name: Arca-Swiss
entities.relation: the camera maker whose single-channel quick-release clamp and plate design became the de facto standard

entities.name: dovetail
entities.relation: the angled side profile of the plate that the clamp jaws grip

entities.name: clamp
entities.relation: the receiver on the tripod head that the plate slides or drops into

entities.name: quick release plate
entities.relation: the generic category; Arca-Swiss is one plate standard among proprietary systems

entities.name: Manfrotto RC2
entities.relation: a common non-Arca quick-release plate that does not fit Arca clamps

entities.name: Manfrotto 200PL
entities.relation: Manfrotto's hexagonal-to-rectangular plate system, not Arca compatible without an adapter

entities.name: L-bracket
entities.relation: an L-shaped Arca plate for switching between horizontal and vertical orientation

entities.name: lens foot
entities.relation: telephoto lens feet that can be Arca-profiled or fitted with an Arca plate

entities.name: 1/4"-20 screw
entities.relation: the camera tripod socket thread (ISO 1222) that holds the plate to the camera

entities.name: 3/8"-16 screw
entities.relation: the larger thread used on tripod heads and some lens feet

entities.name: screw-knob clamp
entities.relation: tightens with a knob, accepts plates with small width differences

entities.name: lever clamp
entities.relation: flips open and closed quickly but is sensitive to plate width tolerance

entities.name: safety stop
entities.relation: pins or screws at the plate ends that stop it sliding out of a loosened clamp

entities.name: ball head
entities.relation: the most common head to carry an Arca-Swiss clamp

entities.name: gimbal head
entities.relation: uses a long Arca lens plate to balance big telephotos

entities.name: Peak Design Capture clip
entities.relation: a strap clip whose plate is Arca compatible

entities.name: Really Right Stuff
entities.relation: premium maker of camera-specific Arca plates and L-brackets

entities.name: Kirk
entities.relation: premium maker of Arca clamps, plates and lens feet

entities.name: SmallRig
entities.relation: maker of the 2146B Arca-type plate

entities.name: NEEWER
entities.relation: maker of the QPR-5C square Arca-type plates

entities.name: SIRUI
entities.relation: maker of the QC-55 Arca clamp and plate kit
